_about: Synthetic recording made by `make fixtures-synth` from fixtures/demo_world.json in the documented response shape; replace with `make fixtures` once a tenant exists. TODO(verify): schema id and value fields of custom alerts.

source.query:
fetch logs
| filter service.name == "payment" and loglevel == "ERROR"
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), interval: 1m

fetch logs
| filter service.name == "checkout" and matchesPhrase(content, "Payment confirmed")
| makeTimeseries confirmed = count(), interval: 1m

fetch logs
| filter service.name == "checkout" and loglevel == "ERROR"
| makeTimeseries errors = count(), interval: 1m

fetch logs
| filter service.name == "email" and loglevel == "ERROR" and matchesPhrase(content, "Bounce")
| makeTimeseries bounces = count(), interval: 1m

fetch spans
| filter service.name == "payment" and span.name == "PaymentService/Charge"
| makeTimeseries p95 = percentile(duration, 95), interval: 1m
timeseries p95 = percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95), by:{service.name, http.route}, filter: service.name == "frontend"
timeseries used = max(jvm.memory.used), by:{jvm.memory.pool.name}, filter: service.name == "checkout"
